source_quote: The University Academic Board is authorized to rule on cases not
answer: The President, Vice Presidents, Deans, and Registrar's Office implement the academic regulations; the University Academic Board rules on cases not covered by them.

source_quote: Pleading ignorance of these regulations or of related publications and announcements
answer: Pleading ignorance of the regulations or of announcements posted on campus boards does not exonerate students from the consequences of violating them.

source_quote: Student petitions to circumvent academic rules must be verified by the academic advisor
answer: Student petitions to circumvent academic rules must be verified by the academic advisor before being forwarded to the responsible entity.

source_quote: Minimum duration to earn a bachelor’s degree
answer: Minimum study period at RHU: three years for BA/BS in Arts and Sciences and for the BBA; three years (6 regular semesters plus three summers) for the engineering BS; four years (8 regular semesters plus three summers) for the Bachelor of Engineering.

source_quote: approved deferment of study, is ten regular semesters for the Bachelor of Science,
answer: The maximum period to earn a bachelor's degree, excluding approved deferment semesters, is ten regular semesters for the BS, BA, and BBA and 12 regular semesters for the Bachelor of Engineering.

source_quote: If, for compelling reasons, a student cannot complete the bachelor’s degree within the
answer: If a student cannot finish within the maximum period for compelling reasons, an extension request may be submitted through the college council for approval by the University Academic Board.

source_quote: Second year: 30-65 credit hours
answer: Class level by earned credit hours: first year 0-29, second year 30-65, third year 66-99, fourth year 100 or more.

source_quote: The minimum semester load is 12 credits, unless the student requires fewer credits to
answer: The minimum semester load is 12 credits unless the student needs fewer to graduate; in exceptional cases the Dean may approve a reduced load of nine credits on the advisor's recommendation.

source_quote: The maximum load in a regular semester shall be 18 credits, which may be increased to
answer: The maximum regular-semester load is 18 credits, which may rise to 19 with the Dean's approval. Up to 21 credits may be allowed if the student (1) has a CGPA of at least 85, or (2) needs 21 credits to graduate and has a CGPA of 73 or above.
review_note: Source sentence lists conditions '(1)...(2)...' without 'or'; reading (1) OR (2) is inferred from the parallel summer rule.

source_quote: The maximum load in a summer semester shall not exceed nine credits. A 10-credit load
answer: The maximum summer load is nine credits. A 10-credit load may be allowed if the student (1) has a CGPA of at least 85, (2) needs ten credits to graduate and has a CGPA of 73 or above, or (3) the schedule includes a one-credit course or lab course.

source_quote: The maximum load for a first-year student is 15 credits in the fall or spring semesters
answer: The maximum load for a first-year student is 15 credits in fall or spring and nine credits in summer.

source_quote: A maximum of 10 Credits A maximum of 10 Credits A maximum of 13 Credits
answer: Students in the Intensive English program may also take courses from their intended program: up to 10 credits at IELP 085, up to 10 credits at IELP 095, and up to 13 credits at IELP 100, from the lists specified per college.

source_quote: The student completes the Schedule Modifications Form, obtains approval from the
answer: Students may add or drop courses during the official drop-and-add period by completing the Schedule Modifications Form, getting approval from the academic advisor and department chair, and settling any financial obligations right after the RHUSIS transaction. If the resulting load is below 12 or above 18 credits, the Dean's approval is also required.

source_quote: Students who do not plan to continue in a course must drop it during the drop/add period;
answer: Students who will not continue a course must drop it during drop/add, otherwise they remain financially accountable. A course dropped in drop/add is deleted from the schedule and the student is relieved of its financial liability (refund policy applies).

source_quote: Students may add one or more courses during the drop/add period. The student must
answer: Students may add one or more courses during the drop/add period and must settle the related fees by the prescribed deadlines.

source_quote: Students who could not register during the regular registration period may register during
answer: Students who missed regular registration may register during drop/add and pay a late registration fee; the fee may be waived for urgent circumstances for new students or those unable to register earlier.

source_quote: The student must retake all failed courses when they are first offered. The student may
answer: Failed courses must be retaken when first offered. A passed course with a grade of 70 or lower may be repeated once to improve the CGPA. All attempts stay on the record, credits count once, and the highest grade is used in the GPA. A course may not be repeated more than two times, including withdrawals.

source_quote: Upon the approval of the college Dean, a student may be allowed to take a substitute for
answer: With the Dean's approval, a student may substitute a required major course if it is not offered or conflicts with another required course in the student's graduating semester, or if the student failed it three times and is not on probation. The substitute must have the same or higher credits and level, be in the same or a closely related field, and have equivalent content.

source_quote: student graduates, provided that the student’s CGPA is not less than 75.
answer: An undergraduate may register for a graduate course in place of a required undergraduate course not offered in their graduating semester, provided their CGPA is at least 75 and the college dean approves.

source_quote: The student is entitled to receive a detailed course syllabus at the beginning of the first
answer: Students are entitled to a detailed syllabus at the first class meeting, including instructor information, course description and prerequisites, outcomes, resources, activities and deadlines, assessment and grade distribution, and policies on attendance and make-up exams.

source_quote: Suppose the number of absences reaches the 15
answer: Students must attend all classes. If absences reach 15%, the student must withdraw from the course and receive a W; if they do not, the instructor submits a forced withdrawal form to the dean by the end of the tenth week. All absences, excused or not, are counted.

source_quote: University in official activities shall be allowed up to 20% absences.
answer: Students representing the country or the University in official activities are allowed up to 20% absences.

source_quote: by completing the attendance exemption form.
answer: If absence is due to ill health or other difficult circumstances, the student must give the instructor evidence and a plan to meet course requirements by completing the attendance exemption form; the absences are still counted.

source_quote: Instructors are required to complete a midterm performance assessment and report the
answer: Instructors must complete a midterm performance assessment and report results before the withdrawal deadline, and at least one major exam should be given before the withdrawal deadline.

source_quote: correct the exam booklets, return them to the students within a week after the exam, and
answer: Instructors must return corrected exam booklets to students within a week after the exam.

source_quote: students with more than two final examinations scheduled on the same day. A student
answer: Instructors may make individual arrangements for students with more than two final exams on the same day. Students cannot sit for final exams without settling all financial obligations to the University.

source_quote: If a student fails to attend a final examination without a valid excuse, the student shall
answer: Missing a final exam without a valid excuse gives a zero. If the absence was beyond the student's control, they may petition the college Dean; if justified, an 'I' (incomplete) grade is recorded and a make-up exam is taken before the next semester's drop/add period. If circumstances persist, the Dean may recommend changing the 'I' to 'WE'.

source_quote: instructor may give the student a make-up exam or shift the weight of the missed exam
answer: A missed exam or quiz usually receives zero. With a legitimate, verifiable excuse, the instructor may give a make-up exam or shift the missed exam's weight (except the final) to other assessments.

source_quote: In all cases, the final exam grade should not exceed 35%.
answer: The final exam should not exceed 35% of the course grade.

source_quote: within two working days of the scheduled final exam time. Within 24 hours afterward, the
answer: Instructors enter grades in RHUSIS and submit the grade report to the Department Chair within two working days of the final exam; within 24 hours the chair verifies it, gets the dean's approval, and forwards it to the Registrar.

source_quote: If a student feels that the grade s/he has attained in a course was unfair, s/he should
answer: A student who feels a grade was unfair should discuss it with the instructor within five days of posting. If unresolved, they may submit a Course Grade Review Petition Form to the department chair within two weeks of posting; if legitimate, the Dean forms a committee (chair, instructor, another faculty member) to investigate.

source_quote: extension to complete the unfinished work by submitting a “Request for Time
answer: A student who completed most coursework but cannot finish for a verifiable compelling reason may request, before the final exam period, an extension via a Request for Time Extension Form. If approved, a temporary 'I' grade is given; the instructor computes a grade with zero for unfinished work, which applies if not completed by the deadline.

source_quote: The incomplete grade must be removed before the beginning of the drop/add period
answer: An incomplete grade must be removed before the start of the drop/add period of the following semester in which the student is registered. Credit is assigned to the semester the course was taken, and graduation is cleared only when all incompletes are resolved; if circumstances persist, a 'WE' may be assigned on the Dean's recommendation.

source_quote: A course grade cannot be changed after it has been submitted. If extreme circumstances
answer: A submitted grade cannot be changed except in extreme circumstances, via a Change of Grade Form from the instructor through the chair and dean to the Registrar within two weeks of grade posting. Grades cannot be changed after the bachelor's degree is awarded.

source_quote: Divide the total quality points by the total credit hours.
answer: Semester GPA: multiply each course's credit hours by its numeral grade to get quality points, add the quality points and the credit hours, then divide total quality points by total credit hours. The higher grade of a repeated course is used, and W grades are excluded.
